programmes.d: Lionfish near the coral reefs off Curaçao; oysters of the Chesapeake Bay; an oil spill's effects in Alaska; rebuilding the Louisiana wetlands.

Hondo's informant friend is killed while seeking information for a joint SWAT and FBI task force; when the FBI task force leader acts erratically, Jessica worries the woman's behavior will endanger the team in the field.

A young heiress is kidnapped for ransom; the team goes on a citywide search to bring her home before she is harmed; the team worries that Mumford is moving too fast when he announces he's getting married for the fourth time.

As the team works to de-escalate a hostage situation, the mission takes a dangerous turn, which impacts the team; Street tires of his complicated romantic entanglements and agrees to let Chris make over his online dating profile.
Hondo confronts his resentment toward his ailing father when he and his sister try to convince their dad he's no longer well enough to live alone; Mumford intends to make Chris a surprising offer.
Jim Street debates whether his mother should live with him upon her release from prison; Hondo and the team are assigned to protect a high-profile Russian journalist who is visiting Los Angeles.
Hondo's life and career are threatened when his off-the-books surveillance of his godson's kidnapper is discovered; Street has trouble acclimating to his newly paroled mother.

Hondo and Deacon must evade a gang of armed mercenaries hunting them in the mountains following an ambush; Chris oversteps his boundaries in an attempt to help a female SWAT trainee who she suspects isn't being evaluated fairly.

A fake 911 call puts Hondo and the SWAT team on the hunt to stop bombing attacks; Street's relationship with his mother jeopardizes his career; Jessica is thrown a curveball by the president of the police commission.
An earthquake hits Los Angeles while the team is engaged in a standoff with human traffickers holding child hostages; Jim Street has trouble adjusting to his new life as a patrol officer.

The SWAT team tries to find a woman and her son who are running from an international drug cartel; Hondo makes a distressing discovery about his incarcerated friend's son; Luca mulls over a government program.
Deputy District Attorney Nia Wells enlists the team to protect the jurors of a high-profile bribery trial after some of them are targeted by organized crime in a series of fire-bombings.

Hondo suspects an ulterior motive when his romantic interest's estranged husband requests the team's help apprehending a fugitive who is robbing drug cargo shipments; Jessica is forced to implement departmental budget cuts.

Hondo and Chris try to infiltrate and take back a cruise ship that's under siege by drug smugglers; Street enters the SWAT training academy and finds the competition fiercer than expected, with all the applicants vying for one position that is open.

The team tries to determine the next diamond dealer to be robbed by thieves executing heists across downtown Los Angeles; Hondo is emotionally affected by a suspect's death; Chris contemplates an unorthodox offer from the new woman she's dating.

The team hunts for a band of criminals re-enacting the crimes of the infamous Symbionese Liberation Army; Hondo experiences discrimination from a fellow officer during a SWAT training seminar for local law enforcement in Arizona.
The SWAT team races to find a stalker pursuing Tiffany, a social media star, after the dangerous admirer turns a fan event into a shootout that endangers Jessica.
When the team is called into work on their day off to end a hostage situation, they discover one of the captives is a wanted felon; Hondo saves his sister after she's given a roofie at a nightclub.

When a 15-year-old who was part of a group of kids who put a transgender teen in the hospital is tried as an adult, the SVU team wonders whether the punishment fits the crime.

When a starving toddler is found wandering the streets, detectives are led to a home where another child is in grave condition; Chief Dodds (Peter Gallagher) suggests that Benson's squad may be undergoing changes.
An unarmed black man is shot during the pursuit of a suspect, raising racial tensions; Barba must indict the three officers involved -- who claim they followed procedure.
Rollins' mother throws her a baby shower; the team's investigation into the rape of a violinist by her colleague leads to Rollins' fugitive sister; Sgt. Mike Dodds reports for his first day.
